input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: A background wait_for watcher hit the 30-minute default background limit while the 40-minute experiment was still running; re-armed with a longer timeout, the experiment itself was unaffected.

doc_friction.issue: Background waiters launched with run_in_background default to a 30 min limit; the note on long jobs could say to pass a timeout above the job's expected runtime when waiting on a 40+ minute run.

Milestone 21's untested mechanism guess was partly settled by a census identity in the code (kappa only moves false-tie weights); reading survey_recall before planning would have shown it, so the plan was rewritten before the run.

deviations.why: The listed test, 'match the weight of mutual false ties and halved true ties at kappa 0.25', turned out to be partly an identity in a census, so it would not have tested anything.
deviations.did: Located the step on a finer kappa grid and isolated the cost of halving true ties with an oracle weighting, plus a seed-set diagnostic.
deviations.result: The step sits between kappa 0.1 and 0.25; halving true ties costs 0.37 point (z 2.6), but the oracle only ties keeping every report.

notes: civ-seeding milestone 22: 8 rules x 10 copies (about 40 min on 4 cores) plus a seed-set diagnostic. Sanity reproduced milestone 21 to 4.9e-6. H69 and H70 refuted, H71 held, H72 refuted, H73 narrowly refuted. Local checks: 92 project tests pass, build.py ok, check_md_links ok, check_posts ok, research_live_links ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a researcher designing, coding, running and writing up one simulation milestone with a diagnostic

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
